definitions.explanation: Single-use chopsticks made of wood or bamboo that come joined together and need to be split apart before use.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}り{箸|ばし}をつけてください。
{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}を{割|わ}るのが{下手|へた}だ。
examples.english: I'm bad at splitting disposable chopsticks.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}のために{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}を{使|つか}わないようにしている。
examples.english: I try not to use disposable chopsticks for environmental reasons.

notes:
{割|わ}り{箸|ばし} literally means "chopsticks that split" ({割|わ}る = to split).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割|わ}り{箸|ばし}を{割|わ}る (to split disposable chopsticks)
- {割|わ}り{箸|ばし}を{使|つか}う (to use disposable chopsticks)
- {割|わ}り{箸|ばし}{入|い}れ (chopstick holder/dispenser)

RELATED TERMS:
- お{箸|はし}: chopsticks (polite)
- マイ{箸|はし}: one's own reusable chopsticks
- {箸置|はしお}き: chopstick rest
